evidence.reason: File writes and the optional browser launch run in the reporting CLI after the candidate checks finish. The engine's data path and core ownership are unaffected.
The HTML verdict uses the same findings or component exit status and behavior results as the command. Export runs before returning a failed gate, preserving its diagnostics.
One embedded template serves both scopes. Export needs only the built xtask. Opening a saved report is opt-in and delegates to the host's URL handler.

MiniJinja and url already ship in the workspace lockfile. HTML autoescaping protects candidate diagnostics and rationale, evidence links use HTTPS or repository files, and the launcher receives a single encoded file URL as an argument.
Renderer tests check escaping, evidence links, missing observations, startup-only applicability and option conflicts. They render in isolated temporary directories and require no browser or network.
